services.title: The capabilities behind the operation.
services.body: For projects in Venezuela, High Valley integrates specialist services through local technical partners. Equipment, personnel and delivery scope are defined for each engagement.

feature.title: Well intervention & artificial lift
feature.body: Coordinate well intervention and restoration services with specialist field teams.

items.title: Well intervention & artificial lift
items.body: Coordinate well intervention and restoration services with specialist field teams.
points: Slickline and electric wireline for well diagnosis, fishing and restoration.
Coiled tubing: cleanouts, stimulation and nitrogen services in intervention.
Gas lift system inspection, repair and downhole support.

items.title: Well testing & production performance
items.body: Bring together the measurements and technical analysis needed to evaluate well performance.
points: Well testing with continuous pressure, temperature and flow monitoring.
Multiphase measurement of oil, gas and water to validate performance.
Production optimization, nodal analysis and wellhead maintenance.

items.title: Engineering & procurement
items.body: Connect project definition with equipment sourcing and commissioning support.
points: Feasibility, conceptual, basic, FEED and detailed engineering.
Equipment and materials procurement, with inspection and import coordination.
Facility upgrades, pre-commissioning and start-up support.

items.title: Maintenance & power systems
items.body: Structure maintenance and electrical support around operational continuity.
points: Predictive, preventive and corrective maintenance focused on continuity.
Electrical distribution, transformers, grounding and instrumentation.
Power generation: supply, installation, operation and maintenance.

items.title: Environmental & site services
items.body: Integrate environmental recovery and site preparation into the project scope.
points: Spill containment, recovery and soil or water remediation.
On-site waste handling and treatment coordination.
Vegetation control and preparation of operational areas.

items.title: Field logistics & fluid handling
items.body: Coordinate movement of fluids, equipment and materials between operational sites.
points: Fluid pumping, transfer, dewatering and transport between sites.
Machinery rental, lifting and earthworks coordination.
Field supply logistics with material traceability.
